description: This file defines a Fragment class (LogFragment) that contains a custom LogView and manages its view hierarchy and behavior, primarily for logging display purposes within an Android app.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass used to display log messages using a custom LogView inside a ScrollView, facilitating logging in the app.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment’s view hierarchy, adds a TextWatcher to auto-scroll the log view to the bottom when text changes.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used in this fragment.
